steps.accents: An accent (>) asks you to play a note louder than the ones around it: a little more weight on that key. Here the first note of each bar has one.
steps.accented: Lean on the accented notes, and keep the others even.
steps.tenuto: A short line over or under a note, tenuto, asks you to hold it its whole length and lean on it a little. Next to staccato notes the difference is easy to hear.
steps.tenutoAndStaccato: Held, short, held, short: watch the lines and the dots.
